subject: Mutual action plan & commit ramp — TPM targets and closing timeline
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@nimble-retail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@nimble-retail.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Nov 2025 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial MAP draft and target TPM for pilot

Hannah / Ben —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, procurement and our product team want a short mutual action plan (MAP) that ties pricing/discounts to committed monthly token (TPM) targets across the evaluation and post-eval ramp. I've attached a first-pass spreadsheet that outlines the timeline we have in mind and some rough TPM numbers.

High-level asks from our side: 
- 30-day pilot with clear success metrics (latency < 500ms p95 for our median prompt, semantic similarity >= 0.88 on the QA set).
- Post-pilot: a 6-month ramp with monthly TPM targets that scale from 10M -> 50M TPM.
- Clarity on pricing tiers and conditional discounts tied to hitting monthly commit gates.

Can your team confirm if Redwood can commit to the MAP structure below (pilot dates, escalation path, and discount triggers)? If so we'll move to procurement questions and aim to close by 12/12.

Attached: Nimble_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP + initial TPM table)

Elena Park
Head of Product Operations
Nimble Retail

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@nimble-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
Date: Wed, 26 Nov 2025 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP draft and target TPM for pilot

Elena —

Thanks for the clear outline and the attachment. We reviewed the spreadsheet; happy to align on a MAP but want to tighten a few points so procurement has a crisp set of acceptance criteria. Below is a proposed MAP summary and conditional discount ladder. If that looks good, we’ll produce a formal MAP PDF and a short SOW to attach to the PO.

Proposed MAP summary (high level):
- Pilot window: 2025-12-08 -> 2026-01-07 (30 days)
- Pilot acceptance gates: p95 latency < 500ms (measured across representative 100k tokens), semantic similarity >= 0.88 on the shared eval prompt set, < 1.5% rate of malformed outputs for structured responses.
- Post-pilot ramp (months 1-6 after acceptance): TPM targets = [10M, 18M, 28M, 36M, 44M, 50M] per month.

Pricing / conditional discounts (applies when monthly commit gate is met by the 5th business day of the subsequent month):
- Baseline rate: $0.0009 / token
- Meet tier 1 (>=10M TPM month): 5% credit applied to that month
- Tier 2 (>=28M TPM): 10% credit + 2% rebate at quarter close
- Tier 3 (>=44M TPM): 15% credit + 5% rebate at quarter close + discounted overage rate at $0.0006/token

Operational notes:
- We’ll provide a shared metrics dashboard (Redwood will push token/latency snapshots; Nimble will share QA eval results).
- KV/prefix caching configuration: Redwood recommends turning on aggressive prefix caching for high-frequency prompts — we’ll include a baseline config in the SOW.

Next steps:
1) Confirm acceptance gates and the ramp TPM numbers above.
2) Redwood to send MAP PDF + SOW and a single-sheet pricing summary by EOD 11/28.
3) If Nimble agrees, procurement provides PO terms and we aim for signature by 12/12.

I’m looping in Marissa (sales lead) and Karthik (solutions) to address pricing and technical tuning.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.example
+1 (415) 555-0123

On Wed, 26 Nov 2025 at 12:15 PM, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example> wrote:
>
> Elena / Hannah —
>
> Thanks — a couple of feasibility notes from pricing: the baseline rate above assumes a quantized model path and standard KV caching. If Nimble requires guaranteed p99 < 750ms for 99% of requests at 50M TPM, we’ll need a dedicated capacity uplift (reserved pool) which changes economics.
>
> Alternative pricing option (reserved uplift):
> - Reserved uplift for months 4-6: fixed monthly fee $35k + lowered per-token baseline $0.00075/token.
> - We can fold the reserved uplift into the Tier 3 discount (effectively making Tier 3 a capped fixed fee + lower token rate).
>
> I’ll prepare both options in the MAP doc for Nimble to choose. Also adding a small acceptance window for remediation (10 business days) before credit is applied to allow config tuning.
>
> —Ben
> Ben Carter
> Sr. Sales Director, Redwood Inference
> ben_carter@redwood.example

From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@nimble-retail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@nimble-retail.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2025 11:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP draft and target TPM for pilot

Hannah / Ben —

Appreciate the clear options. A couple quick clarifications from procurement/product: 
- Can you confirm the exact ramp cadence we should put in the PO? Nimble prefers the month-by-month numbers called out explicitly (we can’t use ranges).
- For the reserved uplift option, what SLA language can you commit to for latency and availability? Procurement wants a remediation credit schedule spelled out.
- We’d also like a 30-day pilot cost estimate (token burn only) and a single DocuSign link for the MAP + SOW if possible.

If you can get the MAP PDF + SOW and a DocuSign placeholder by EOD 11/30 we’ll aim to route internally and come back with PO language the week of 12/1.

Thanks,
Rajiv
Director, Platform Product 
Nimble Retail

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.example>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@nimble-retail.com>, Elena Park <elena.park@nimble-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP draft and target TPM for pilot — MAP PDF and next steps

Rajiv / Elena —

Attached is the MAP PDF and a concise SOW (Redwood_Proposal_NR-059.pdf) that enumerates the month-by-month TPM targets (explicit numbers listed), acceptance gates, and both the baseline and reserved uplift pricing paths. DocuSign placeholder is linked in the HubSpot deal and we’ve added a one-page SLA addendum for the reserved uplift option.

Quick answers: 
- Ramp cadence: we put the explicit numbers in the SOW as requested — months 1-6 = 10,000,000; 18,000,000; 28,000,000; 36,000,000; 44,000,000; 50,000,000 tokens respectively.
- SLA language (reserved uplift): 99.9% availability target, p95 < 400ms; remediation credit schedule included in addendum (credits scale from 5% to 20% of monthly uplift fee depending on severity).
- Pilot cost: we included a conservative token-only estimate for 30 days at the pilot baseline rate (est. $8,500) — final depends on actual burn.

If Nimble approves the MAP + SOW, next steps we propose:
1) Procurement to return PO terms by 12/03.
2) Execute DocuSign by 12/07.
3) Pilot kickoff 12/08 if signatures complete.

If procurement needs to rework contract language, loop Marissa for any commercial escalation.

Thanks — we’re ready to move quickly on the MAP and pilot.

Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.example
